title: Container or workflow orchestration?

rows.label: What it orchestrates
values: The order of steps in a process

rows.label: Unit of work
values: A pod or task that should stay up
A step that runs and finishes

rows.label: When something fails
values: Retry the step, branch, or compensate

tip: Both get called “orchestration”, which causes endless confusion. One keeps servers alive; the other keeps a business process moving.
